title: Planar herald decoder survey and integration
summary: Survey and reusable integration of configuration MAP, planar logical ML, transfer and controlled MPS on the classical herald channel over p,q in [0,1].
current_focus: Full-domain exact-planar phase diagram delivered with independent confirmation, size drift and explicit unresolved regions.
next_action: No pending work for this campaign; higher-precision thermodynamic convergence or a physical-channel extension needs a separately scoped study.
motivation: Separate intrinsic logical recovery from posterior-inference and matching losses.
question: Which methods can become reusable standard decoders, and what do matched performance and runtime establish?

results.title: Exact planar full-domain decoding-phase diagram
results.summary: Fresh full-domain exact logical-ML evidence. Left: L24 mean conditional Bayes risk, linear display interpolation; dots sampled cells. Middle: L24−L8 pointwise 95% size-trend evidence plus near-maximal finite-size risk plateaus and exact uniform syndrome-only nonrecovery point (gray unresolved), dotted analytic sufficient-recovery bound; between-node coloring interpolates the display score clipped at ±6. Right: crossing intervals for L8/16, L16/24, L24/32. Single stable candidates use local-window bootstrap95; overlapping or unstable candidate intervals are merged into envelopes marked ×, not pooled confidence intervals or distinct physical transitions. All raw crossing candidates remain in the analysis. Statistical uncertainty does not include lattice-size drift or interpolation bias. No complement folding or forced single threshold.

results.title: Conditional logical-risk objective gap
results.summary: Selected sector expected loss minus exact planar conditional Bayes risk, averaged over 200 records. Error bars ±1.96 sample SE. Exact reference zero; MPS posterior agreement is cohort-specific.

results.title: Warmed per-shot decoder latency
results.summary: Pooled equal-size fresh eight-cell mix:1600 timings/method/size, one CPU thread; excludes graph setup and independent first call. Median and p95. BP is belief matching (synchronous cap40), not standalone BP; no claim of native or asymptotic speed.

results.title: MPS and Kac–Ward approximation diagnostics
